Ways to practice

So many ways onto the mat

From strong vinyasa to slow tai chi, joyful dance to guest-led master classes. All levels, both rooms.

Vinyasa

Breath-linked flow that builds heat and leaves you clear. The daily heartbeat of both rooms.

All levels60–90 minBoth

Mat Pilates

Core, control and precision on the mat. Strength you feel the next morning.

All levels60 minEast Village

Foundations

Slower and cue-rich. Learn the shapes and the breath without rushing.

Beginner60 minBoth

Basics

An unhurried entry point. Come exactly as you are, no experience assumed.

Beginner60 minAstoria

Tai Chi

Slow, continuous moving-meditation. Balance, patience, a quieter nervous system.

All levels60 minBoth

Dance

Expressive, joyful movement. Cardio that never feels like exercise.

All levels60 minBoth

Master Classes

Guest-led deep dives with visiting teachers. Occasional, worth planning for.

Intermediate90 minBoth

Candlelit Restorative

Supported shapes held long by candlelight. Let the nervous system exhale.

All levels60 minAstoria

Breathwork

Classical pranayama and holotropic-inspired breathing, on the new and full moon.

All levels75 minEast Village

Cacao Ceremony

A heart-opening ceremonial cacao circle. Grounding, communal, warm.

All levels90 minEast Village

Astoria Park Outdoor

Seasonal free-air flow under the trees by the water.

All levels60 minAstoria

Donation-based

Pay what you can. Yoga that stays open to the whole neighborhood.

All levels60 minAstoria
